mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% in 3 months, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST/RSAFS decline fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized) signals supply chain stress, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings growth stalls.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle expansions does not yield negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction effect not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, directly driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed Fed rate cuts and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced household income.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE/PAYEMS deterioration fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term not significant.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 110) during early expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals robust supply chain activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via sustained corporate growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth in early expansions does not yield positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction effect not significant (p>0.05).
